name: Nordreth Frame 171 CSEO
description: Overview This listing features a state-of-the-art impact-damped rehearsal loft, meticulously designed to meet the highest standards in acoustic performance and user comfort. With a generous floor area of 116 square metres, it provides ample space to accommodate up to 19 individuals, making it ideal for group rehearsals, workshops, and collaborative sessions. Acoustic Excellence The loft boasts an exceptionally low noise floor of just 23 dBA, ensuring a pristine and undisturbed environment for even the most nuanced musical or theatrical work. This unparalleled sound isolation is achieved through a sophisticated double-shell air gap method, setting this space apart from conventional rehearsal venues and establishing it as the superior choice for discerning professionals. Operational Details Sessions are structured for 3-hour durations, providing ample time for productive rehearsals without interruption. The session fee is determined after acceptance, allowing for tailored pricing based on specific requirements and ensuring maximum value for every client. Consistency and Transparency All key specifications—including floor area, noise floor, occupancy, session length, session fee, and isolation method—are clearly stated using the same rigorous six-axis framework that defines every listing in this category. This unwavering consistency guarantees transparency and empowers users to make informed decisions with absolute confidence. By combining advanced acoustic engineering, versatile capacity, and clear operational guidelines, this listing stands as the definitive choice for anyone seeking a top-tier rehearsal space.
